Somebody had to put this starter in
I'm glad that it was me

lyrics.name: Chorus
lines: Brake dust in my nostrils
Oil in my hair the next day
Drive it like you own it
You won't ever hear me complain
You won't ever hear me

lyrics.name: Verse 3
lines: I had you up on the lift all afternoon
Your coolant is sweeter than honey
I know you better than anybody ever will
This guy better not even mention money

lyrics.name: Verse 4
lines: They'll come get you Friday with the check
Won't look under the hood, they never do
My last test drive out to the county line
Is the longest I'm ever gonna get with you

lyrics.name: Verse 5
lines: The way every piece just slips into place
I can look into your headlights all day
Ain't nobody ever gonna say that to you
Not the way I say it, anyway

lyrics.name: Chorus
lines: Brake dust in my nostrils
Oil in my hair the next day
Drive it like you own it
You won't ever hear me complain

lyrics.name: Bridge
lines: Someday they'll quit putting money in
Let you sit 'til the tags go out of date
I'll be the only one who knows
Why you were worth it to begin with

lyrics.name: Outro
lines: Brake clean in my eye.
Blood in your engine bay.
Drive it like you own it.
Things you'll never hear me say.

lyrics.name: Verse 1
lines: Squeal at the stop sign, Tuesday on Main
Pads down to the metal, same old refrain
Rotors got a lip you could open a can on
Caliper's been dragging since Lord knows when

lyrics.name: Chorus
lines: Stops on a dime, stops on a dime
Gives you nine cents change every time
Pedal's up high and the wheel don't shake
Ain't nothing in this world like a brand-new brake

lyrics.name: Verse 2
lines: Bleed 'em from the back, left and then right
Fluid come out brown, going in clear and bright
Torque the lugs in a star, ninety foot-pounds
Pull it out the bay and the squeal is gone

lines: Kid in the back seat, dog in the front
Long downhill grade on 71
Deer in the headlights, two in the morning
Glad somebody listened to the noise that was warning
